name: Sweet Mint | KSHN 10mg THC Pouch [20ct]
description:
Ready to trade the old ways for a new kind of high? Meet the Sweet Mint KSHN Pouch, an uplifting, flavorful rebel of the cannabis world. Crafted by Michigan connoisseurs and made in small, high-quality batches, this isn’t your grandma’s edible (seriously, it’s NOT an edible! See instructions below).

This is your “café dose” designed for session use so you can stay in the driver’s seat and build your buzz. It’s clean, discreet, hands-free, and smokeless. Tuck it, suck it, love it, and no one has to know. Puck comes with 20 pouches.

Forget the guessing game. Our Cool Processed™ Nanoemulsion isn’t magic, it’s just science. We break down the molecules so the good stuff (THC) gets a fast-track right into your bloodstream. It completely bypasses your body’s usual, complicated digestive detour. The bottom line? A more predictable, fast-acting, and long-lasting ride.
